label: TP
reason: Alert-TP driven by java/xss: User input from request.getParameter() flows through param.replace("\"", """) to bar, then directly into HTML attribute at line 35. While double quotes are escaped, other dangerous characters (< > &) remain unescaped, allowing XSS attacks like <script>alert(1)</script>. Resolved sink value depends on attacker-controlled input.

evidence.note: User input retrieved from request parameter, transformed with replace(), written to HTML response without full sanitization
